s.note: Barry burning through energy at super speed
s.how: Whisk 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 eggs and 375ml buttermilk to a thick batter. Cook small pancakes in butter until golden. Fry 8 rashers of bacon until crisp. Stack the pancakes high with bacon between them and pour over maple syrup.

s.note: the Icelandic fishing village where Bruce finds Arthur
s.how: Spread rye crispbreads with creme fraiche. Top each with a fold of smoked salmon, a sprig of dill and a few thin rings of pickled onion. Lay them out on a slate and serve cold, like a snack in a fishing village on the edge of the world.

m.note: Diana and her home island of Themyscira
m.how: Rub a 2kg lamb leg with lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano, olive oil and salt. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes, then rest for 15 minutes. Toss chopped tomatoes, cucumber and crumbled feta with olive oil and lemon and serve with the sliced lamb.

w.how: Melt 150g sugar to an amber caramel, then whisk in 150ml cream and 30g butter with a pinch of salt. Scoop vanilla ice cream into bowls and pour over the warm caramel. Scatter with popping candy just before serving so it crackles.

d.note: Arthur Curry knocking back whisky in the village
d.how: Simmer 3 tbsp honey with 3 tbsp water and 1 tbsp grated ginger for 2 minutes, then cool and strain. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml Scotch whisky, 1 tbsp of the ginger syrup and the juice of a quarter lime to each. Top with 150ml cold ginger ale and stir once. Garnish with a lime wedge. For non-drinkers, skip the whisky and double the ginger syrup.
